query:
SELECT ua.id, ua.actionType, ua.feature, ua.description, ua.segmentCount, ua.imageUrl, ua.sourceImageUrl, ua.createdAt
FROM app_users au
JOIN user_actions ua ON ua.appUserId = au.id
WHERE au.email = 'yossi2700@gmail.com'
ORDER BY ua.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 3;
